When you ask multiple people for advice, you are most likey to make the decision that everyone is satisfied with. Asking only one person does not give you the advantage of hearing different opinons. If you ask multiple people, the best answer will be brought up more than once. Listening to multiple people and their solutions may help you come up with an idea that you have not thought of. Only asking one person for advice is less beneficial, for everyone and for yourself.

Asking multiple people for advice will give you different perspectives on how you should handle the problem. When choosing what to do, having an idea of what might happen next will impact your final say for the better. Having different opinions on the matter will help you rule out the unfavorable ones, and leave you with the ones you are most satisfied with. The people you ask will provide you with perspectives that you did not think of, helping you put an end to your issue.

Multiple people being asked the same question will definitely bring up the same answer more than once. On an issue that requires guidance, your friends will probably bring up the answer that another friend already brought up. Getting the same solution over and over again may mean that it is the most reasonable answer. Asking only one friend may prevent you from getting the answer that makes the most sense.

Getting advice from multiple people may help you come up with an answer you did not think of. Getting different perspectives might help you to come up with your opinion on the matter. Your friends opinion may influence your own, creating a solution you did not think about. If you ask only one friend you get only one perspective to help influence your own for the better or worst.

Asking multiple people is the best way to insure that you will get the answer that sits well with everyone. If you ask one person their answer could be affected by other variables, so asking multiple people is your best and safest bet. The benefits of asking more than one person for advice are huge so you should be taking advantage of that. When you do ask the ones you trust for advice, the solution will eventually make its way to you.

Education is much more important than money! In some societies, students are expected to identify a career by the time they enter high school. Their courses of study in the high school are selected to guide them toward a specific career. I believe that it's not a good idea for students to commit to a career at a young age, because it's not logical, most experts also find it wrong and I have a personal experience to share about this topic to reinforce my opinion.

Firstly, expecting students to commit to a career doesn't make sense to me, because every age has their own responsibilities and I don't think that committing a career is the responsibility a student in high school should take.

Although, when they start their career in high school, they start earning money; I believe that a good education is like an investment and much more important than a little amount of money you gain in high school. Because, students should take Math to challenge and improve their brain capacities, while learning stuff that will help them in their future life, English to express their opinion and understand other people better, History to learn about their ancestors and their ancestors' mistakes to not do the same mistakes in their future life, Economy to learn how to manage their money and this list goes on... In a nutshell, each classes we take in high school has their own meaning and purpose to make the students better and more successful person in the future.

Now, while education is that important, if a student starts his/her career without education, he/she starts the life "0-1" behind the other people. We can imagine this like an exponential growth problems. If a person gets 1 dollar every day for a month, he will totally get 30 dollars at the end of the month. But if another person gets 2 pennies for the first day, then the money he gets doubles every day, he will totally get 2^30 dollars which is an amazingly huge money that I can't even write. Even in the 10th day, the second person will get more money than the first one. So we can see that even though it looks like second person will get less money than the first person, the exponent (power) of 2 pennies will make a huge difference in the future. My point is that education is like exponents. It looks like the students who starts his/her career in high school years have more advantages in real life, however, the reality is totally the opposite. And by the way, if we offer these two options to an educated and a non-educated person, most probably, non-educated person will choose the first option, while educated person will choose the second option. I think this definitely proofs my opinion.

Also, I think most of the experts are agree to my opinion, they also think that students should go to school and get the best education they can get, instead of an education for a specific career. Since I am from Generic_City, I know that a person can't legally work, if he/she is under 18 years old in Generic_City. The reason it's not legal to work under 18 in Generic_City is (though there are lots of people working illegally) because experts and lawmakers think it's not student's responsibility to work at that age. I believe there are similar laws in different countries.

From the newspaper I read last week, there is going to be a meeting next week; experts, teachers and lawmakers will discuss this problem and try to increase the attendance to high school and colleges in Generic_City, by promoting education and giving scholarships to poor kids, so they can focus on their education.

Finally, I want to share my personal experience. In Generic_City, unfortunately, education system is not great. The attendance to high school and college was even worse in past decades. So I can compare people who started their career and who focused on their education during high school.

If I make a report about people I know from Generic_City and how their careers are, according to their education level, their career and level of education they got would be directly proportional. And I think, I am very lucky to be able to see this difference, thanks to my dad and his friends & relatives. Fortunately, my dad got his education from one of the best universities in Generic_City, so he also helps me to see and understand the difference. I believe that if a person is non-educated, it's reason is mostly their parents and/or teachers. Of course laziness of the person is also one of the reasons, but adults has to promote education because at that age, a person can't have the adequate vision to see how important it is.

In conclusion, although some people encourage students to start their career in high school, I disagree to that opinion because students should get and focus on the best education they can get during their high school and college years.

We discussed the importance of education logically, we understood that experts also agree, and finally I shared my own experience. I hope everyone can get the best education they can get and focus on that instead of starting their career at that age.

I think that the policy of having a C average to play sports should stay the same,

because its not fair that a student can't play a sport just because they don't

have a B average or higher. But I also think that all students should have better grades than a C average so they can be successful.

If the policy changes the students should be able to practice but shouldn't be allowed

to play in game until they get higher grades.

Sincerely,

Student.

Dear Principal,

The school policy that you have decided upon is necessary that students must have a grade B average to play sports is not a good idea in my mind. Many students are at a grade C average and are playing meaning that they are already trying their best to be in the sports.

When a student is pushed a little to do better they react accordingly but, when they are pushed to across their limit they tend to feel overwhelmed and agitated. This overwhelming feeling can lead to procrastination and laziness, which will lower their grades which would then lead to a domino effect until they are failing. This could happen or the student would feel that they do not need to go to school anymore because they have nothing to look forward to there. Then the student may influence others and create a ring of truancy which is worse than low grades.

The students who enjoy these extracurricular activities usually are concentrating on doing their best in sports or their extracurricular activities, if we could move their priorities without side effects we could be able to reach higher levels of learning although a grade B average sounds like the best thing to do for this, it is not. Sometimes when students have a large load of homework or tests they feel the need to relax and forget about their stress, but if they need to get even higher grades the outcome would be either of these three extremes, extremely low grades, truancy, high grades (but not enough time for sports) without a lot of time students agitation would reach to a point where they might resort to drastic efforts to relieve stress, like suicide. This would then mold the school into an unfriendly jail cell, and other students will be effected.

Instead of a grade B average as the policy, you should have a tutor at the extracurricular activities who can put in a little bit of teaching while the students are having fun. The connection of fun and learning can lead grade C average students to achieve higher grades and do better in school. Also if you can design rewards for students with higher grades the students with low grades will want to reap from the tree of knowledge to receive rewards, this in turn will yield higher grades, less procrastination, less anger, and all without any harmful side effects.

Sincerely,

STUDENT_NAME

Many students in high school do not know what type of career they want to follow. Schools have partnerships with companies that allow students to find an occupation they are interested on through internships and shadowing opportunities, managers contact students to visit their business and help them discover whether or not they should work on that career. Although some people think that schools should not partnership with companies to allow students explore whether or not they are interested in pursuing a type of employment, nevertheless, schools should work with companies, and managers should allow students to visit their business because it can help students discover whether or not they like the type of employment they choose to visit, students can take classes related to the career they choose during high school, and it can allow students to gain experience on that type

of career.

To begin, Schools should work with companies, and manager should allow students to visit their business because it can help students discover whether or not they are interested in the type of employment they choose to visit. For example, if a student is interested in choosing cosmetology as a career and this student is allowed to visit a beauty salon, while this student is at the beauty salon and sees stylists how they work with hair, skin, and nails on costumers, and learns about how the atmosphere is at beauty salons this student will discover at a young age if

he or she will enjoy this career in their future. This shows that if a student is allowed to visit a business related to the career they are interested on they will know if working in this career makes them happy and if they enjoy it. Clearly, it is a great idea for managers to invite students to their business and help them discover if they are really interested in the career.

Furthermore, schools should work with companies, and managers should invite students to visit their business because students can take classes related to the career they choose in high school. For instance, as said before, if one wants cosmetology as a career and

is invited to a beauty salon, one will know what classes to take during high school and one will know what one should practice the most, for example if haircuts are performed more than hair color, students can practice more on how to do a good haircut, This means that if

students are invited to visit a work place they want to work in the future, students will know what employees do at the work place and will know what classes to take during high school that will help them with this career. obviously, inviting students to visit work places will help them know what classes to take while in high school and will help them know what to practice more.

Moreover, as previously said, schools should work with companies, and managers should invite students to visit their business because it can allow students to gain experience while at the work place they visit. For example, if one is interested in cosmetology and is invited to visit a salon beauty one will see and learn how stylists work at their job and one may be able to greet costumers and do them a service with help of professional stylist. This shows that one will have experience from the visit one had during school for the future and will know how it is to work with costumers, what services costumers ask the most for and it will be much easier for one when one starts to work. clearly, it is important for schools to work with companies, and it is a great idea for managers to invite one to visit their business so one can have experience.

Some people may believe that having managers invite students to their business is a waste of time, however, it is helpful for students to go visit a work place they are interested on. In conclusion, it is a great idea for schools to work with companies, and managers inviting students to visit their business because it can help students decide if they like or do not like the career they want to choose, it can help students know what classes will prepare them for their future job and it will allow students to gain experience.

Jefferson once wrote that people should never choose to be inactive and that one should use that time to be accomplishing goals. Some may argue to this, but Jefferson had many valid points. By always doing something one would get experience, accomplish more for trying, and putting effort into life.

To accomplish a goal, one would need experience in that area. The only way to get experience is to stay active and get familiar with the goal. It would not help by being inactive. For example, if a person's dream job is to become a doctor. The person cannot just slack around and not use their time wisely. They need to be taking classes that would help, or be searching up ideas that could help them achieve that goal. If they were to be inactive, they would be nowhere near to accomplishing that goal. Inactivity drags out the waiting process, when doing this it takes longer to complete the task.

Being inactive means that the effort is not there. If there is no effort put into a goal, then how is the goal going to get accomplished? People can not just expect things to be handed to them. That is not a healthy mindset or lifestyle. People need to work for what they want. How can one get through life by relying on others constantly? If a person were to be sitting around and not putting in any effort, it just means that they are lazy. The hard work and effort is what helps people accomplish tasks or goals quicker.

What happens when one puts all their effort into a goal, but ends up failing? In the moment it may look like a waste of time, but it was not. It is okay to fail; all that matters is that one tried. Sometimes we do not accomplish the original goal, but instead we accomplish all the other goals along the way that reached there. A person accomplishes more for trying, compared to another individual who does not try at all.

Some may argue how people may be using their time to accomplish bad or useless goals. This does not matter because everyone has different goals in life. One person may think of a goal as useless, but yet to someone else it is extremely important. All that matters is that a person puts in the effort, gets the experience and accomplishes their goal.

Technology has made our world drastically different than ever expected. New technological breakthroughs are happening everyday to help make our society ,and daily lives, simpler. While technology is wonderful, it causes an enormous amount of problems for humans altogether. With a society that is so prone to technology, we as people, are slowly becoming socially inept, incapable of completing simple tasks on our own, and even becoming more and more lazy, and inactive, everyday. These effects of technology are not something the world should look past and forget.

With the rise of technology everyday, people are always using it to communicate with one another. Cellphones, for example, help us to text ,and or, call our friends and loved ones when ever we please; however, we as a society have grown too attached to this concept. Especially in teenagers, technology is stunting the growth of teenage social skills. I have struggled with this myself; with the constant use of my phone, I struggle with encounters with, not only other teenagers, but with adults too. It has become a drastic problem in our daily lives, and is making our connections to other people weaker as a result. People may say that technology helps them stay close and connected, but in reality, it is pulling us farther apart.

Shopping online is something that has always made life easier. Everything that we need can be brought to us with the click of a button which, in some cases, is needed, but as a society; we have become too reliant on everything being too easy for us. Technology has made our lives to simple and does not allow humans to improve on any of their life skills. People struggle with many things in life that span from going to the store to even at their own work place. This is very dangerous for younger generations of children and teens who are still growing up. Hundreds of parents give their kids technology instead of, teaching life lessons, experiences, and giving them goals to complete; therefore, not allowing the children to gain the basic needs of life.

Playing games on a phone or other device is a good way to pass time or to just entertain ones self; however, people today are using them way to frequently. Laziness has plagued or society due to the constant use of technology; whether it is an adult, teen, or child, technology has made us nonproductive in our daily lives. This is a serious matter on all fronts; we live in a world where being active is critical to ones health and well being. People are now preferring to stay inside their homes and do nothing, instead of, going out and doing something productive with their lives. This stunts their health and growth as a human being all together.

Technology has changed our world in ways no one could have imagined, but with all the negative effects present because of it, it is hard to ignore the all the downsides to it. With people now losing social skills, the ability to do simple tasks, and even having the ability, and motivation, to get up and do something productive, it makes it clear that technology could be changing us for the worst. Hopefully as time goes by, we as humans find a better way to restrict ourselves from so much technology use so we can have a brighter future as a society.

Studies show that giving students holiday breaks monthly is a distraction from their classes. Once the start the holiday routine starts, getting a break from all the heavy-load classes will be the only thing in a teenagers mind. Some people argue that there should be year-round schools, but this path only leads to students losing their strict work habits and motives for better grades. Therefore, a long summer break helps students to relax and recharge for couple months before they start the new year stronger and motivated.

Summer is a good opportunity to develop themselves both in school and out of school. American school system provides students an opportunity of summer school. Most students take this chance to raise their grades, while others retake failed classes. Summer school is one of the options to keep your mind fresh and updated. On the other hand, there are plenty of job opennings in summer. People who would like to use the time they have productively can apply for a job to make some extra buck. Applying for a job gives real-life experience, and it can benefit on the persons future interests. Eventhough the job you applied for is not your dream job, it will make a difference on your CV such as work experience. As a result, long breaks could be beneficial, and it is completely up to the person to use the time wisely or to waste it.

Furthermore, apart from some set classes students pick their own classes and each year they get to have a new timetable. They do not learn the same things they learnt a year ago, but it adds information to a persons background knowledge. As an example, in maths students learn a different curriculum each year to expand their knowledge rather than concentrating in one area. Besides after a year long of hard-work and dedication they earn a one long break. High schools are too tight with deadlines and tests that students never get a chance to do something other than school-work. Most juniors and seniors did not had the chance to get a driving license or to participate in any social responsibilty activities in the past few years. Which means if they did not have the summer break to catch up on these activities, it would be impossible to do it in the academic year. Having year-round breaks might be good to get recharged once in a while, but a short break would not create any productivity.

United States is twenty-seventh in the world for it's academics, meaning people are not productive in their holiday breaks. Countries like Great Britain and Finland are using the same system, but they are in top three in the world. Critics say that schooling system is not working. However, having breaks monthly will be a distraction and students will lose more focus. In conclusion, system is not failing students are, and to change that: they must change the habits of the lifestyle they live with.

There are many reasons behind school should not be year around. Students deserve to distract their minds off classes for a period. This will lead to motivation, temptation, and determination. Students will come back stronger, with bigger goals ahead of them.
